item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 07/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, there will still be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong today. Temperatures will fall slightly. It will be windy and the weather will improve over the coastal areas of southern China during the weekend. The monsoon is expected to moderate gradually early next week. Temperatures will rise over the region.

Date/Month: 07/04 (Friday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. A few showers at first. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 19 - 24 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
